preamble: Write ONE self-contained HTML file (inline CSS and JS, no external assets, no build step). For 3D use only core three.js via: import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js' inside <script type="module"> (no addons, no OrbitControls). Fullscreen canvas, starts animating immediately, no user input needed, no console errors. HARD LIMIT: your whole reply must be under 8000 tokens. Reply with the raw HTML only, no explanation, no markdown fences.

tasks.walker: TASK: a 3D articulated humanoid (head, torso, upper/lower arms, upper/lower legs, hands, feet, built from primitives with proper joint hierarchy) walking in place on a checkered floor with a natural gait (opposite arm/leg swing, knee and elbow bend, body bob, slight torso twist). Add a directional light with soft shadows, a coloured point light, fog, and a camera that orbits the character smoothly.
tasks.physics: TASK: a 3D physics sandbox with NO physics library: 150+ coloured spheres of varied size are dropped continuously into a glass-like open box, with gravity, sphere-vs-sphere collisions, wall/floor collisions with restitution and friction, using InstancedMesh. Shadows on, slowly rotating camera, a periodic 'shake' of the box so the pile keeps moving.
tasks.gears: TASK: a procedural clockwork machine: at least 8 meshing gears of different tooth counts (teeth generated procedurally, correct opposite rotation and ratio between meshing neighbours, arranged in a 3D layered layout), plus pendulum and a ticking second hand, metallic materials with environment-style lighting (fake it with lights), subtle camera drift.
tasks.shader: TASK: a full-screen WebGL fragment shader (raw WebGL or a three.js full-screen quad) raymarching an animated signed-distance-field scene: a morphing blobby object over an infinite repeating floor with soft shadows, ambient occlusion, fresnel glow and a moving camera. Must compile on first try.
